label: Server Port
tip: Set which networking port the local server will use. By default, LM Studio uses the port 1234. You might need to change this if the port is already in use.

label: Require Authentication
tip: When enabled, only requests that include the Authorization header with a Bearer $LM_API_TOKEN value will be allowed.

label: Serve on Local Network
tip: Whether to allow connections from other devices on the network. If not checked, the server will only listen on localhost.

label: Allow per-request MCPs
tip: Allow using MCPs that are not in your mcp.json. These MCP connections are ephemeral, only existing as long as the request. At the moment, only remote MCPs are supported.

label: Allow calling servers from mcp.json
tip: When enabled, allows API clients to use servers you defined in your mcp.json in LM Studio. This can be a security risk: in case you defined MCP servers that have access to your file system or private data. This option requires "Require Authentication" to be enabled.

label: Enable CORS
tip: Enabling CORS (Cross-origin Resource Sharing) would allow websites you visit to make requests to LM Studio server. CORS might be required when making requests from a web page or VS Code / other extension.

label: Just-in-Time Model Loading
tip: When enabled, if a request specified a model that is not loaded, it will be automatically loaded and used. In addition, the "/v1/models" endpoint will also include models that are not yet loaded.

label: Auto unload unused JIT loaded models
tip: A model that was loaded Just-in-time (JIT) to serve an API request will be automatically unloaded after being unused for some duration (TTL).

label: Only Keep Last JIT Loaded Model
tip: Ensure at most 1 model is loaded via JIT at any given time (unloads previous model)
